alex (new hire): hey team — quick Q. my offer says 401k match begins on my hire date (2026-03-02) but onboarding email said "first paycheck" for eligibility (my first FT paycheck is 2026-03-20). i also elected HSA during onboarding but i don't see any HSA deferral on my 3/20 stub. can we confirm effective dates and whether i missed something?
tori (People Ops): welcome! :wave: short answer: our standard policy is match on deferrals taken on paychecks after you're onboarded as an employee (so match generally starts with the first FT paycheck). if the offer language is explicit about hire-date eligibility, please upload the offer PDF and i'll review for an exception. for HSA, sometimes HRIS->payroll sync misses the election — send the onboarding confirmation and we'll trigger the payroll sync or an off-cycle.
alex (new hire): attached offer snippet says "employer match effective on date of hire." uploaded offer.pdf and onboarding-confirmation.pdf to the HR ticket. also fyi i had a small contractor payout in early march that's been corrected on our payroll side.
tori (People Ops): thanks. two tracks: 1) we'll ask compensation/legal if offer wording overrides standard effective date and escalate if so; 2) if payroll mis-tagged your status and withheld deferral incorrectly, we can request an off-cycle employer contribution (requires manager approval + comp change docs). for HSA: if no wages were in the pay period when the election should've applied, deferrals won't appear — we can request a pre-tax off-cycle contribution to the HSA custodian but tax timing matters.
marc (Benefits): vendor notes: 401k plan code PLAN-RED-401 (7102). HSA custodian HST-3301. Off-cycle posting steps: People Ops submits Off-cycle Request with CompChangeForm.pdf, DeferralReport.csv, and ManagerApproval. Vendor typically posts within 1-2 pay cycles. Vesting per plan doc; contractor time not auto-credited unless service-credit form submitted.
payroll-bot: automated: Off-cycle checklist & sample CSV available at https://intra/payroll/offcycle-guides. Example row: "hris_id,period_start,period_end,employee_deferral,employer_match". Please ensure attached docs reference payroll journal id.
tori (People Ops): alex — i'll start the review and ping your manager for approval if we need off-cycle. thanks for uploading the docs. expect update within 3 business days.
